history: Zhuhai became a Special Economic Zone in 1980 and is famous for its cityscape: the Fisher Girl — 'a pearl born of shell, a shell born of sea' — is its symbol. The 55-km Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macao Bridge, the world's longest sea crossing, opened in 2018. Sunsets on Lovers' Road and Chimelong's whale-shark hall earned it the name 'City of Romance'.
importance: Special Economic Zone · City of Romance
